The
Jean Coutu Group
is a major Canadian pharmacy chain operating over 400 franchised stores in Quebec, Ontario, and New Brunswick. It features exclusive private-label lines alongside
a vast network of global manufacturing and cosmetic brand partners
Proprietary and Private-Label Brands
Personnelle:
Jean Coutu's primary flagship private label encompassing cosmetics, beauty accessories, skin care, and baby care items.
Pro Doc:
The in-house generic drug manufacturing subsidiary of the Jean Coutu Group, supplying equivalent generic pharmaceutical products to their network.

sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/31364/000104746904037057/a2147423zf...: Each of François Jean Coutu and Michel Coutu, who are sons of Jean Coutu, have worked in the retail drugstore business for more than 27 years. Mr. Jean Coutu and his family, directly or indirectly, hold shares of capital stock that represent approximately 48% of our outstanding equity.
